artworks.title: Alphonso, King of Castile
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a suit of armor with a cloak and holding a lance. He has a beard, short hair, and wears a hat with a feather. The background includes an arch, columns with carvings, and a landscape with hills and buildings. The style of the illustration resembles an etching or engraving.

artworks.title: Alphonso, King of Castile
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body portrait of a bearded man standing in a contrapposto pose. He holds a lance-like object in one hand and rests the other on a sword hilt. He wears a detailed suit of armor with intricate patterns, suggesting a regal or knightly status. His facial features include a long beard, a defined nose, and deep-set eyes with a stern expression. He wears a flat cap with a decorative feather, and a cape drapes over his shoulders, partially covering the armor. In the background, there is an architectural archway with carvings, revealing a landscape with mountains and a small town or fortress.

artworks.title: Fernando Alvarez de Toledo, Duke of Alva
artworks.description: The image shows the upper torso of a man in ornate armor, facing forward with his head turned slightly to the side. He has distinctive facial features, including a long, wavy beard and mustache. The man wears elaborate armor with intricate designs and a draped sash. The portrait is presented in an oval frame, with a textured background inside the frame and a plain outer area.

artworks.title: Amalia, Wife of Fredierick Henry, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing, gazing at the viewer with a composed expression. She has intricate feathered hair and prominent facial features. She is wearing an elaborate dress typical of the early modern period, with a lace collar. She holds a closed book and a fan with feathers. The background shows a rural landscape with windmills. Decorative text above and below the figure suggests the woman's name and titles.

artworks.title: Dutch Ambassadors
artworks.description: The image is an aged etching featuring twenty portraits arranged in a grid of five rows by four columns. Each individual is depicted from the chest upwards and is oriented to the front, with the head turned to varying degrees. The subjects are all middle-aged to older men with various styles of facial hair. Their hair is short or receding. They are dressed in formal attire, characterized by ruffled collars and cloaks or coats with large lapels. Below each portrait, there is an inscription detailing the name of the person depicted. The background of the image is simple, with a clear separation between each portrait.

artworks.title: Lancelot Andrewes, Bishop of Winchester
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He is seated or positioned upright with his left hand resting on the arm of a chair and his right hand delicately holding a book. His facial expression is calm and composed, with prominent eyebrows and a neatly trimmed mustache and beard. The individual is wearing a traditional academic or clerical garment, which includes a high-collared ruffled shirt and a long academic robe. His head is adorned with a cap, consistent with academic tradition of the period. An intricate coat of arms is placed above the man's head, surrounded by elaborate scrollwork that includes Latin text. The background is a plain, darker texture that allows the detailed figure to stand out. Surrounding the central image is more scrollwork with additional text, giving the portrait a formal and ornate presentation.

artworks.title: Lancelot Andrewes, Bishop of Winchester
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up, in a seated position. He has a solemn expression, with his eyes looking downward. The man has a prominent nose, a mustache, and a pointed beard. He is wearing a dark cap, a high-collared ruffled shirt, and a heavy dark cloak over a robe. His hands are positioned over a book, with one hand supporting its spine and the other pointing to the pages. There is no visible jewelry on him. The background consists of a decorative oval frame enclosing the portrait, with the Latin text "EFFICIES RP LANCELOT ANDREWS EPISCOPI WINTONIENSIS" around the oval, identifying the figure as Lancelot Andrews, Bishop of Winchester. Below the portrait is a poetic inscription and a crest, rendered in a vintage or historical engraving style.

artworks.title: Andreas, Cardinal of the Holy Roman Empire
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man known as Andreas, Cardinal of Austria. He is depicted facing slightly to the right, wearing a distinctive hat and elaborate clothing with a textured pattern. The man has facial hair that merges into his mustache, closely cropped hair, and a calm expression with eyes averted. The ornate frame around the portrait includes cherubic figures, helmets, spears, a battle scene medallion at the top, and a panel with ships at sea below.

artworks.title: Francis, Duc d'Anjou, Son of Henri II
artworks.description: The image shows an oval-framed portrait featuring a man from the chest up. He is centered, facing forward with a slight turn to his right. The man has wavy hair, a full mustache, and beard. He has sharp facial features and is dressed in a formal jacket with a large ruffled collar. The portrait is adorned with a decorative border and an inscription above the oval. Below the portrait is a block of cursive writing. In the background are simple and patterned details.

artworks.title: Anna, Daughter of Duke of Julich and Cleves
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woman from the waist up. She is facing slightly to the right with her gaze towards the viewer. The woman has a long face, dark eyes, and a slight smile. Her hair is styled upwards and back, with a decorative headpiece. She is wearing a detailed dress with a ruffled collar, a beaded necklace, and a single earring. The background includes a circular frame with an inscription and decorative designs. Below the portrait, there is text.

artworks.title: Anna, Wife of Matthias, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a woman's body. She is seated, facing forward with her body slightly turned to the side. Her facial features include a prominent forehead, delicately arched eyebrows, expressive eyes, a small straight nose, and subtly upturned lips. Her hair is styled back and held in place by an ornate crown or headpiece with floral motifs. The hair is gathered in a smooth fashion at the back. She wears a high-collared garment with a ruffled lace collar and intricate patterns with small floral designs. The background is a textured, dark oval frame with a lightly detailed border. An inscription identifies her as a noble of Austrian and Roman background.

artworks.title: Anna, Wife of Matthias, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing upright and angled slightly to the left. She has delicate facial features, an elegant expression, and styled hair with a tiara. She wears royal clothing, including an elaborate gown with a ruffled collar and a bejeweled cross. In her hands, she holds a scepter and an orb. A crown is placed on a table next to her. Light streams through a circular-patterned window behind her, illuminating a textured curtain background.

artworks.title: Anna Regina (Anne, Queen of France and Navarre)
artworks.artist: Jeremias Falck after Justus van Verus
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a regal woman from the waist up. She has curly, shoulder-length hair and a calm expression, with distinctive eyebrows and partially closed lips. The woman is wearing a richly detailed garment with a lace collar and a fur-trimmed cape draped over her shoulders, adorned with pearls and embroidery. She wears a small crown on her head, indicating her royal status, and holds a fan in one hand. The background features an ornate frame with various elements, including a crown and floral motifs above her head, symbols in circular panels on either side, and additional ornamental objects such as a helmet, a sword, and branches. The lower edge of the frame includes an inscription referring to her as a queen.

artworks.title: Anne Boleyn
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a woman's upper body, from her waist to just above her head. She is facing slightly to the left, with detailed facial features including pronounced cheekbones, a straight nose, and slightly upturned lips. She has intricately styled hair under a pearl-adorned headpiece. She wears richly decorated clothing with detailed patterns, puffed sleeves, and a square neckline with embroidery. Adorned with a necklace and a cross, she also wears bracelets on her wrists. Her hands are positioned gracefully, with one lightly touching the cross. The background features ornate swirls and an oval frame. Latin text is above the frame, while English text below describes the subject of the engraving.

artworks.title: Anne of England
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a seated woman in an oval frame with ornate border designs. She has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and pursed lips. Her hair is styled tall with a decorative hairpiece. She wears a detailed garment with a lace collar, adorned with buttons. She wears earrings and a pearl necklace. The background features floral elements and a Latin inscription around the oval frame.

artworks.title: Anne of England
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a woman facing forward and looking at the viewer. She has an oval face, high cheekbones, prominent eyes, voluminous upstyled hair with a large hairpiece, ornate royal attire with a lace collar, a multi-strand necklace, and an elaborate earring. The background features a circular frame with laurel leaves and Latin inscriptions. At the bottom, there is a section with additional script.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body view of a woman sitting down, facing the viewer. She has a regal and composed expression, with elaborate headwear, styled hair, a detailed dress, and various accessories. She is holding a fan in her left hand. The background features decorative elements and text.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman's upper body. She faces the viewer with her head slightly turned to the right. She has a prominent chin, full lips, and almond-shaped eyes. Her hair is styled high and adorned with jewelry. She wears an elaborate outfit with a lace collar, a dark gown with a decorative pattern, and jewelry around her neckline. The background is plain, emphasizing the subject's attire and demeanor.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark
artworks.description: The image displays a woman standing in a full-length portrait. She is slightly turned, with her body facing forward and her gaze averted. The woman has curly hair, delicate facial features, and wears an elegant gown with ruffled sleeves, a floral ornament, and a decorative sash. She poses with one hand on her hip and the other holding the drapery near her chest. The background features a detailed tapestry with tree and figure motifs against a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria, Wife of Louis XIII
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a woman from the shoulders up. She has a composed expression, delicate facial features, and short, wavy hair. She wears an elaborate garment with intricate patterns and a large, stiff lace collar. She has a beaded necklace around her neck and an ornate chain with a cross pendant. The portrait is encircled with text featuring her name and titles, and below the image is a block of text in a poetic format. The artwork likely uses an engraving technique due to the detailed line work and shading throughout.

artworks.title: Portrait of Man in Oval
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustrated man's upper body in a frontal position from the chest up. The man has long, wavy hair, a full beard, and mustache. His facial expression is neutral, and his features include a prominent nose and lips. He is dressed in historical European formal attire with a wide collar, buttons, and a sash with a clasp. The background is a dark oval framing the man on a lighter textured paper. The illustration is in a monochrome style, resembling an engraving or etching.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Nun Holding Crucifix
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woman shown from the waist up. She is facing forward with a slight tilt of her head to one side. Her facial features show a serene expression with a small, closed-mouth smile, and her eyes are looking at the viewer. She has a rounded face framed by a head covering, revealing a smooth forehead. Her hair is hidden under a wimple and veil. She wears a traditional nun's habit with a headpiece and robe flowing over her shoulders. She holds a small cross in her hands, clasped together in front of her. The background features an oval frame with a textured pattern, bordered by lines and geometric shapes.

artworks.title: Man With Ruffled Collar
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man's upper body. He is facing slightly to his right, with his shoulders and head clearly visible. The man has distinctive facial features, including a mustache and a chin beard. His curly hair is styled with volume. He is wearing a ruffled collar and a richly patterned garment with decorative details. The background features an oval frame with surrounding text.

artworks.title: Jan van den Wouwer
artworks.description: The image shows an oval-framed portrait of a person. The individual is portrayed from the waist up, facing slightly left and looking towards the viewer. They have short hair, a mustache, and a small goatee. The person's expression is neutral. They wear a classical-style garment draped over one shoulder with visible folds. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with faint lines, resembling aged paper. The portrait is centered in a rectangular void space.
